children: DA Davidson maintained their Buy rating on C&F Financial's stock with a price target of $124.00.
The price target implies an upside of 14.2% from the Oct 27 close of $108.57.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: C&F Financial Corp reported third-quarter earnings per share (EPS) that exceeded expectations, driven by higher net interest income (NII), loan growth, and ongoing expansion of net interest margin (NIM), which collectively indicate a robust financial performance and effective management.

: The company is expected to achieve mid-single digit loan growth of approximately 7% in 2027, alongside annual tangible book value (TBV) per share growth in the mid-teens, positioning it for continued profitability improvement and justifying a premium valuation compared to peers.
